unified_relative_shape_v2__lgbm.title: Unified Relative Shape v2 — LightGBM
unified_relative_shape_v2__lgbm.subtitle: Current unified model (simulation firewall)
unified_relative_shape_v2__lgbm.short_explanation: Selected as the best methodologically clean model under unified_feature_contract_v2. Uses 12 relative/ratio features that are dataset-agnostic by design. Reduced domain fingerprinting from 1.0000 (legacy) to 0.9591. Highest deployment score (0.4691) among all 30 trained models.
why_selected: 12 pure ratio/relative features (e.g. sz_cv, sz_p25_median_ratio) resist dataset-level fingerprinting.
Domain AUC reduced from 1.0000 (full_canonical__lgbm) to 0.9591 — meaningful reduction.
Highest deployment score (0.4691) balancing LODO transfer, domain AUC penalty, FPR and ECE.
Compact model: 12 features, fast inference, no session-level aggregation.
Fully runtime-compatible: all features computable from live packet stream.

calibration.warning: High ECE (~0.30). Probability values reflect rank order well but should not be interpreted as calibrated probabilities in production.

caveats: ECE = 0.2988 — probability values are poorly calibrated. Rank-order is reliable but absolute scores are not.
FPR = 0.0759 — approximately 7.6% of benign flows are flagged at the REVIEW threshold.
Domain fingerprinting persists: domain AUC = 0.9591. A classifier can still identify the source dataset from features at above-random accuracy.
LODO-ISCX AUC = 0.637 — transfer to completely unseen ISCX-style captures is limited.
LODO for USBVPN not available: USBVPN test set is almost entirely benign (cannot compute AUC reliably).
Live PCAP validation: schema-confirmed only. Full end-to-end live PCAP test has not been run with real traffic.
action_mode = simulation. No packets are blocked.

full_canonical__lgbm.title: Full Canonical — LightGBM (Legacy)
full_canonical__lgbm.subtitle: Legacy mixed-feature baseline
full_canonical__lgbm.short_explanation: Former top model from the final_transfer experiment. Achieves excellent pooled AUC (0.9994) but suffers from complete dataset fingerprinting (domain AUC = 1.0000), meaning a classifier can perfectly distinguish the source dataset from features alone. Also affected by cross-dataset feature-definition mismatches in direction_balance and dispersion_symmetry features that were only discovered during the unified_feature_contract_v2 audit. Not the recommended model for thesis/publication.
why_not_selected: domain_auc = 1.0000: complete dataset fingerprinting. Features encode the dataset identity.
Feature-definition mismatch: direction_balance_bytes, direction_balance_packets, dispersion_symmetry used different formulas across ISCX/VNAT/USBVPN.
live_extractor_compatible = False: legacy feature extraction path uses inconsistent formulas.

calibration.warning: Excellent ECE — but calibrated on a fingerprinted feature space. ECE validity is questionable for OOD data.

caveats: domain_auc = 1.0000: model may be exploiting dataset-level statistical artifacts.
Feature-definition inconsistency discovered post-hoc in unified_feature_contract_v2 audit.
Legacy aggregation is per-session (not per-flow). Different probability output format.
live_extractor_compatible = False: formulas differ from unified extractor.
This model is NOT the recommended thesis model.

robust9_clean__lgbm.title: Robust9 Clean — LightGBM (Legacy)
robust9_clean__lgbm.subtitle: Legacy compact 9-feature baseline
robust9_clean__lgbm.short_explanation: Compact 9-feature model using only packet size statistics. Useful as a size-features-only baseline. Superseded by the unified_relative_shape_v2 and unified_size_shape models.

metrics.note: Full per-split metrics not re-evaluated in unified_feature_contract_v2 pipeline.

caveats: Compact model but uses raw size statistics (not ratio/relative features).
Not evaluated under unified feature contract.
Domain AUC unknown in unified pipeline.
Comparison/documentation only.

anti_fingerprint_hybrid__lgbm.title: Anti-Fingerprint Hybrid — LightGBM (Legacy)
anti_fingerprint_hybrid__lgbm.subtitle: Pre-unification anti-fingerprint attempt
anti_fingerprint_hybrid__lgbm.short_explanation: An earlier attempt to reduce domain fingerprinting by selecting features with low domain importance. Despite 12 carefully selected features, domain AUC remained near 1.0 (0.9999). LODO-min = 0.443. The unified_relative_shape_v2 approach is strictly better.
caveats: domain_auc = 0.9999 despite anti-fingerprint feature selection.
Pre-unification: feature formulas inconsistent with unified extractor.
LODO-min = 0.443, much lower than unified_relative_shape_v2 (0.637).
Superseded. Comparison only.

lodo__iscx_held_out__lgbm.title: LODO — ISCX Held-Out (Negative Control)
lodo__iscx_held_out__lgbm.subtitle: Leave-one-dataset-out negative control
lodo__iscx_held_out__lgbm.short_explanation: Trained on USBVPN+VNAT, evaluated on ISCX. Demonstrates what happens when a completely unseen dataset is encountered. AUC = 0.637 (near-random for VPN detection on ISCX). Not a deployable model. Report/robustness analysis only.
caveats: Intentionally underpowered: trained without ISCX to test generalization.
AUC = 0.637 on ISCX — this is the honest cross-domain transfer performance.
Not deployable. Not selectable in benchmarks.

lodo__vnat_held_out__lgbm.title: LODO — VNAT Held-Out (Negative Control)
lodo__vnat_held_out__lgbm.subtitle: Leave-one-dataset-out negative control
lodo__vnat_held_out__lgbm.short_explanation: Trained on USBVPN+ISCX, evaluated on VNAT. AUC = 0.956 — VNAT-style captures transfer well from ISCX/USBVPN. Not deployable. Report/robustness analysis only.
caveats: VNAT transfer works better than ISCX transfer.
Not deployable. Robustness report only.

diverse_bagging_robust9.title: Diverse Bagging Robust9 (Legacy Ensemble)
diverse_bagging_robust9.subtitle: Legacy 9-member XGB/LGBM/CatBoost bagging ensemble
diverse_bagging_robust9.short_explanation: A 9-model diverse bagging ensemble (3×XGB + 3×LGBM + 3×CatBoost) from the ensemble experiment. Overall test AUC = 0.9903. Does not use the standard feature_order.json schema. Not selectable in unified benchmark comparisons. Reference only.
caveats: Non-standard artifact format: no feature_order.json.
Per-session aggregation, not per-flow.
Not selectable in unified feature benchmark.
Report-only reference.
